# GrandOrgue MCP — Full Documentation

## Overview
GrandOrgue MCP connects GrandOrgue pipe organ simulator to AI agents and a modern web console. It provides MIDI bridge control, organ management, sample set discovery, and Bach MIDI repertoire via MCP tools and REST API.

## Ports
| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| Backend (HTTP/MCP/WS) | 11010 |
| Frontend (Vite dev) | 11011 |

## MCP Tools (30)

### Process Control
- `go_status` — GrandOrgue process, MIDI, and organ status
- `go_start` — Launch GrandOrgue
- `go_stop` — Terminate GrandOrgue

### MIDI Bridge
- `go_midi_connect` — Open MIDI bridge ports
- `go_midi_disconnect` — Close MIDI bridge
- `go_list_midi_ports` — List system MIDI ports

### Organ Control
- `go_play_note` — Play a single MIDI note
- `go_play_chord` — Play a chord
- `go_set_stop` — Toggle a drawstop via MIDI CC
- `go_set_crescendo` — Set crescendo pedal position
- `go_set_enclosure` — Set swell enclosure level
- `go_combination` — Trigger a general piston
- `go_panic` — All-notes-off
- `go_send_sysex` — Send raw SYSEX data

### Organ Management
- `go_load_organ` — Load an organ by name/path
- `go_auto_load` — Reload last-used organ
- `go_unload_organ` — Unload current organ
- `go_list_organs` — List installed sample sets
- `go_marketplace_search` — Search free sample set catalog
- `go_marketplace_download` — Get download URL for sample set
- `go_bach_catalog` — Browse Bach organ works catalog

### MIDI Playback
- `go_play_midi_file` — Play depot MIDI file via keystroke injection
- `go_play_midi_file_ui` — Play depot MIDI file via pywinauto
- `go_midi_playback_status` — Whether MIDI playback is active
- `go_stop_playback` — Stop MIDI playback

### MIDI Depot
- `midi_depot_list` — List MIDI files
- `midi_depot_upload` — Upload MIDI file (base64)
- `midi_depot_download` — Download MIDI file (base64)
- `midi_depot_delete` — Delete MIDI file
- `midi_depot_download_bach` — Fetch Bach MIDI bundle

## REST API Endpoints
| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | /health | Liveness probe |
| GET | /api/status | Server status |
| GET | /api/settings | App settings |
| PUT | /api/settings | Save settings |
| GET | /api/midi/ports | List MIDI ports |
| POST | /api/midi/connect | Connect MIDI |
| POST | /api/midi/disconnect | Disconnect MIDI |
| POST | /api/midi/play | Play MIDI note |
| POST | /api/midi/stop | Stop playback |
| GET | /api/midi/playback-status | Playback status |
| POST | /api/note | Play note |
| POST | /api/note/off | Release note |
| POST | /api/stop | Set stop |
| POST | /api/crescendo | Set crescendo |
| POST | /api/enclosure | Set enclosure |
| POST | /api/combination | Trigger combination |
| POST | /api/panic | All-notes-off |
| GET | /api/go/status | GO process status |
| POST | /api/go/start | Start GO |
| POST | /api/go/stop | Stop GO |
| GET | /api/organs | List organs |
| POST | /api/organs/load | Load organ |
| GET | /api/organs/last | Last loaded organ |
| GET | /api/catalog | Free catalog |
| GET | /api/marketplace/search | Search marketplace |
| GET | /api/bach/catalog | Bach catalog |
| GET | /api/midi-depot | List depot files |
| POST | /api/midi-depot/upload | Upload to depot |
| GET | /api/midi-depot/{name}/download | Download from depot |
| DELETE | /api/midi-depot/{name} | Delete from depot |
| GET | /api/midi-depot/{name}/raw | Raw download |
| POST | /api/midi-depot/batch/bach | Download Bach bundle |
| GET | /api/llm/providers | LLM provider discovery |
| POST | /api/llm/chat | LLM chat |
| GET | /api/skills | Skill listing |

WebSocket: `/ws` — real-time organ status push

## Environment Variables
| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| PORT | 11010 | Backend HTTP port |
| HOST | 127.0.0.1 | Backend bind address |
| MCP_TRANSPORT | stdio | Transport mode (stdio/http) |
| GRANDORGUE_TAURI | — | Set by Tauri wrapper |
| GO_EXE_PATH | — | GrandOrgue executable path |
| MIDI_DEPOT_DIR | — | MIDI depot directory |
| GO_MIDI_RECORDINGS_DIR | — | MIDI recordings dir |
| OLLAMA_BASE_URL | http://127.0.0.1:11434 | Ollama endpoint |
| LMSTUDIO_BASE_URL | http://127.0.0.1:1234 | LM Studio endpoint |

## Architecture
- Dual transport: stdio (Claude Desktop/mcpb) or HTTP (webapp)
- FastAPI with CORSMiddleware, MCP mounted at `/mcp`
- WebSocket for real-time organ state broadcast
- MIDI via python-rtmidi (virtual MIDI ports)
- GrandOrgue process management via subprocess + pywinauto
